answer: Keeping 165 aliases alive hence means 165 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ember quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the voyage log exposes the live set and the umber audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 606 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
